takeaways.title: War, Regime Change, and Competing Explanations
takeaways.detail: Use Fearon, Bunce, and Huntington to compare rationalist bargaining, democratization, and broad civilizational explanations. Ask what each theory treats as the causal mechanism and what evidence could disconfirm it.

takeaways.title: Water Links Belief, Infrastructure, and Authority
takeaways.detail: Water is simultaneously material and symbolic. Religious practice, irrigation, spatial organization, labor, and political control should be analyzed together rather than as separate histories.

takeaways.title: Environmental Policy Turns Values Into Rules
takeaways.detail: Week 3 connects competing environmental values to policy instruments, legal authority, enforcement, and the distribution of costs and benefits. Unit 1b is now correctly filed with this week.

takeaways.title: Solar Geometry Drives Seasonal and Local Energy Patterns
takeaways.detail: Axial tilt, solar altitude, day length, surface properties, and instrument placement connect lecture-scale seasonality to lab-scale microclimate observations.

takeaways.title: Good Measurement Requires Consistent Reference Conditions
takeaways.detail: Coordinate systems and body assessments both become interpretable only when the reference system, units, procedures, and measurement conditions are recorded consistently.
